args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`), and a follow-up status check confirms the service is now **healthy** (error rate 0.002) in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required.
